# chains: (Z mother of X) then X father of Y (Y = wife's father's ... ) check via relation tracing
def rel(opt):
    t=opt.split()
    # tokens: Z op1 B op2 T op3 J op4 L
    ops=[t[1],t[3],t[5],t[7]]
    return ops
def ok(opt):
    o=rel(opt)
    # A model: Z ? B, B x T, T & J, J ! L  => B father of J, J wife of L
    return o==['?','x','&','!']
opts={'A':'Z ? B x T & J ! L','B':'Z ? B ! T & J x L','C':'Z ! B x T ? J & L','D':'Z & B ! T x J ? L'}
res=[k for k,v in opts.items() if ok(v)]
assert res==['A']

import itertools
views=[('D', ('B', 'F')), ('D', ('X', 'N'))]   # (common face, [top, side] pairs in the same rotational sense)
common=views[0][0]
pairs=[v[1] for v in views]
others=sorted(set(x for p in pairs for x in p))
ring=None
for p in itertools.permutations(others):
    if p[0]!=others[0]: continue
    cyc=list(p)
    def consec(a,b): return any(cyc[i]==a and cyc[(i+1)%4]==b for i in range(4))
    if all(consec(a,b) for a,b in pairs):
        assert ring is None
        ring=cyc
opp=({'A','B','D','F','N','X'}-set(ring)-{'D'}).pop()
opts={'A': 'A', 'B': 'F', 'C': 'N', 'D': 'B'}
assert opp==opts['A']
for k,v in opts.items():
    if k!='A': assert opp!=v

verifications.check_code:
from itertools import combinations
# line segments (grid units: x 78,143,182,195,247,298,350,402 ; y 40,123,135,180,235,292,347)
H=[(40,78,350),(135,78,182),(123,195,298),(180,143,350),(235,195,402),(292,78,350),(347,298,402)]
V=[(78,40,292),(182,40,135),(350,40,292),(195,123,235),(298,123,235),(143,180,292),(247,180,292),(298,235,347),(402,235,347)]
def hcov(y,x1,x2): return any(yy==y and a<=x1 and x2<=b for yy,a,b in H)
def vcov(x,y1,y2): return any(xx==x and a<=y1 and y2<=b for xx,a,b in V)
xs=sorted({v[0] for v in V}|{h[1] for h in H}|{h[2] for h in H})
ys=sorted({h[0] for h in H}|{v[1] for v in V}|{v[2] for v in V})
n=0
for x1,x2 in combinations(xs,2):
    for y1,y2 in combinations(ys,2):
        w,h=x2-x1,y2-y1
        if abs(w-h*1.0)>0.2*max(w,h): continue
        if hcov(y1,x1,x2) and hcov(y2,x1,x2) and vcov(x1,y1,y2) and vcov(x2,y1,y2): n+=1
opts={'A':9,'B':11,'C':10,'D':13}
assert n==opts['B'], n
for k in 'ACD': assert n!=opts[k]
